Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is the organization responsible for publishing the annual report and preparing the core analyses for the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] [^src1]. Acting as the technical and knowledge-driven force behind the database's quality measurement, the institute plays a central role in evaluating and reporting on Denmark's ADHD treatment standards [^src1]. 

The institute's analytical work underpins the 2024 annual report, which represents a historic expansion of the database's scope. This report marks the first complete measurement of ADHD treatment quality in Denmark, encompassing children, youth, and adults across both public and private healthcare sectors. Through its evaluations, the institute assesses the healthcare system's ability to meet national quality indicators. Furthermore, its reporting identifies critical structural barriers to quality care, including inadequate IT support, insufficient staffing resources, fragmented treatment pathways between different providers, and a lack of proper data registration.
